mapper.select:
select LINING_CODE, listagg(sm.MACHINE_ID,',') within group (order by sm.MACHINE_ID) as machine_ids from T_NC_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_NC_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by LINING_CODE
